Reporting and Stakeholder Management Prepare accurate C&B analyses, dashboards, executive reports and presentations for HR leadership, senior management and Finance. Bachelor/Master degree in Business Administration or equivalent. Solid knowledge of compensation principles, market benchmarking, job evaluation and incentive-plan administration. Experience with benefit-plan administration and international mobility is strongly preferred. Knowledge of Swiss payroll, social-security charges and Swiss employment law is an advantage. English proficiency (C1), French mandatory Advanced Excel skills and strong proficiency with HR systems and data reporting tools.
